register_train_model_dependencies: register model dependencies in a fairseq2 DependencyContainer for training recipes
create_model_holder_singleton: create a singleton _ModelHolder that wraps a torch.nn.Module in the dependency container
prepare_model_with_recipe: prepare a model by calling the recipe setup_model and prepare_model hooks
register_train_model_bootstrapper: register the standard train model bootstrapper type in the dependency container
register_train_model_metadata_saver: register a metadata saver wired to the checkpoint directory path
